author: S3M3L
body:
Reported Player(s): Zook52
Rules broken: He was using TNT to blow up own team both at our spawn and running around teamplayers placing tnt around us. I reported it multiple times, still no mod came to take a look at it. If you look to the right you will see a huge hole where he blew up team.
Evidence: See pictures.

http://i.imgur.com/T6XKpZ0.png

replies.author: RCMP_Mountie
replies.body:
Sorry, but even with the multiple screenshots, this is insufficient evidence to warrant a punishment against the player. A video or more screenshots showing him lighting the TNT should suffice next time.

Thank you for the report, and hope you have a good day!
